_comment: Per-project, per-environment BUILD configuration.
This file answers one question the platform could not previously answer:
'the user picked project X, branch Y, environment staging -- what makes the
artifact a *staging* artifact?'. Before this existed the answer lived only in
local, never-pushed git commits, so wiping repos/ silently produced production
artifacts from a staging branch and every staging scenario failed preflight.
Versioned on purpose: a fresh Mac gets working staging builds from a clone of
this repo alone -- no pbxproj edits, no hand-made commits, no copied .app.
MATCHING: an entry is matched by project 'match' (bundle_id and/or name), so
adding a project here never requires touching platform code. Environments list
ONLY the settings they override; anything absent keeps the project's own value.
An environment that is not listed is NOT SUPPORTED -- the platform says so
rather than guessing.
iOS note: settings under 'build_settings' are passed to xcodebuild as
SETTING=VALUE overrides. That keeps the application checkout clean -- nothing
in the app repo is edited to produce a variant. It works because Info.plist
reads $(PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER); a project that hardcodes the id in an
.xcconfig instead will fail the post-build identity check, loudly, by design.
api_base_url is deliberately OPTIONAL and unset for Vya: staging and production
intentionally share one backend here. Do not invent a staging URL just because
an environment is named 'staging'.
